parts:
Hi all!
I'm trying to use INLA to fit a model with Gaussian likelihood. The mean is the product of a linear predictor and a parameter gamma^2. The variance is also the same parameter gamma^2. 
my problem lies in specifying that the same parameter is involved in both the link and the error variance.

Thank you in advance for any help or advice.
Best regard,
Martin
